description_en: Queries the configurations of an HTTP listener
name: DescribeLoadBalancerHTTPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The listener port to query. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的监听端口。取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

BackendServerPort.description_en: The port used by the backend server of the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535
BackendServerPort.description_zh: 负载均衡实例后端服务器使用的端口，取值：1~65535

Bandwidth.description_en: The peak bandwidth of load balancing. Default value: -1, which indicates that bandwidth is not limited
Bandwidth.description_zh: 负载均衡带宽峰值，默认值为-1（表示不限速）

Description.description_en:
The description of the listener. The description must be 1 to 80 characters in length.
It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
Description.description_zh:
设置监听的描述信息。长度限制为1~80个字符。
不能以`http://`和`https://`开头

ForwardPort.description_en: The forwarding port for HTTP-to-HTTPS listeners

HealthCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether health checks are enabled. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
HealthCheck.description_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：
on：开启。
off：关闭

HealthCheckConnectPort.description_en:
The port used for health checks. Valid values: 1 to 65535. If this parameter is not specified, the backend server port (BackendServerPort) is used.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckConnectPort.description_zh:
健康检查使用的端口，取值：1~65535。不设置此参数时，表示使用后端服务端口（BackendServerPort）。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckDomain.description_en:
The domain name used for health checks.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckDomain.description_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckHttpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code that indicates a successful health check. Valid values:
http_2xx (default)
http_3xx
http_4xx
http_5xx
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckHttpCode.description_zh:
健康检查正常时的HTTP状态码。取值：

http_2xx（默认值）。
http_3xx。
http_4xx。
http_5xx。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckInterval.description_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Valid values: 1 to 50. Unit: seconds.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckInterval.description_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。取值：1~50，单位：秒。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckMethod.description_en:
The HTTP method used for health checks. Valid values:
head: Requests only the header of the page.
get: Requests the specified page information and returns the entity body.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckMethod.description_zh:
监听HTTP类型健康检查的健康检查方法。取值：

head：只请求页面的首部。
get：请求指定的页面信息，并返回实体主体。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckTimeout.description_en:
The timeout period for a health check response. If a backend ENS instance does not respond within the specified timeout period, the health check fails.
Default value: 5.
Valid values: 1 to 300.
Unit: seconds.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on.
If the value of HealthCheckTimeout is less than the value of HealthCheckInterval, HealthCheckTimeout becomes invalid and the timeout period equals the value of HealthCheckInterval
HealthCheckTimeout.description_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ENS在指定的时间内没有响应，则判定为健康检查失败。
默认值：5秒。
取值：1~300。
单位：秒。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效。
如果HealthCHeckTimeout的值小于HealthCheckInterval的值，则HealthCHeckTimeout无效，超时时间为HealthCheckInterval的值

HealthCheckURI.description_en:
The URI used for health checks. The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length.
The URI cannot be only a forward slash (`/`), but it must start with a forward slash (`/`).
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckURI.description_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。长度限制为1~80。
URL不能只有`/`，但必须以`/`开头。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthyThreshold.description_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before the health check status of a backend server is changed from fail (unreachable) to success (reachable). Valid values: 2 to 10.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthyThreshold.description_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由fail（后台服务器不可达）判定为success（后台服务器可达）。取值：2~10。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

IdleTimeout.description_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Default value: 15. Valid values: 1 to 60. Unit: seconds.
If no request is received within the specified timeout period, load balancing temporarily interrupts the current connection and establishes a new connection when the next request arrives
IdleTimeout.description_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间，默认值：15秒，取值：1~60，单位：秒。
在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接

ListenerForward.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTP-to-HTTPS forwarding is enabled. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off (default): disabled
ListenerForward.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP至HTTPS的转发。取值：
on：是。
off（默认值）：否

RequestTimeout.description_en:
The request timeout period. Default value: 60. Valid values: 1 to 180. Unit: seconds.
If a backend server does not return a response within the specified timeout period, load balancing stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
RequestTimeout.description_zh:
指定请求超时时间，默认值：60秒，取值：1~180，单位：秒。
在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回HTTP的504错误码

Scheduler.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:
wrr: Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests.
wlc: Requests are distributed based on the weights and actual loads (connections) of backend servers. If two backend servers have the same weight, the backend server with fewer connections receives more requests.
rr: Requests are evenly and sequentially distributed to backend servers.
sch: Consistent hashing based on source IP addresses. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.
qch: Consistent hashing based on QUIC Connection IDs. Requests with the same QUIC Connection ID are distributed to the same backend server.
iqch: Consistent hashing based on specific three bytes of the iQUIC CID. Requests with the same second to fourth bytes are distributed to the same backend server
Scheduler.description_zh:
调度算法。取值：
wrr：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。
wlc：除了根据每台后端服务器设定的权重值来进行轮询，同时还考虑后端服务器的实际负载（即连接数）。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。
rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器。
sch：基于源IP地址的一致性Hash，相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。
qch：基于QUIC Connection ID一致性Hash，相同的QUIC Connection ID会调度到相同的后端服务器。
iqch：针对iQUIC CID的特定三个字节进行一致Hash，第2~第4三个字节相同的会调度到相同的后端服务器

ServerCertificateId.description_en: The ID of the server certificate

Status.description_en:
The status of the listener. Valid values:
Running: The listener is running.
Stopped: The listener is stopped.
Starting: The listener is starting.
Configuring: The listener is being configured.
Stopping: The listener is being stopped
Status.description_zh:
当前监听的状态。取值：

Running：正常运行。
Stopped：运行停止。
Starting：启动中。
Configuring：配置中。
Stopping：运行停止中

UnhealthyThreshold.description_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before the health check status of a backend server is changed from success (reachable) to fail (unreachable). Valid values: 2 to 10.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
UnhealthyThreshold.description_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由success（后台服务器可达）判定为fail（后台服务器不可达）。取值：2~10。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

XForwardedFor.description_en:
Indicates whether the X-Forwarded-For header is used to retrieve the originating IP addresses of clients. Valid values:
on (default): enabled.
off: disabled
XForwardedFor.description_zh:
是否开启通过X-Forwarded-For字段获取来访者真实IP。取值：
on（默认值）：开启。
off：关闭
